title: Consolidate plan execution onto WorkflowEngine and retire System B
task_summary: Consolidate two non-integrated execution systems onto System A (WorkflowEngine + AgentCoordinator) with persistence, retries, and dependency-aware parallelism. Retire the legacy System B's standalone execution and polling loop.

previous_step_review.checked: src/core/account_pool.py, src/core/coordinator.py, src/clients/local_db.py, supabase/schema_local.sql, src/core/config_loader.py, src/api/jules_accounts.py

files_changed.change: Widen context type to dict[str, Any] and added assign_to, prompt_id, exit_criteria, and execution_mode fields.
Added assign_to, prompt_id, exit_criteria to agent_tasks table, and execution_mode to workflows table.
Updated SQLite schema definition and added table migrations in _migrate_tables for the new fields.
Re-implemented parse_plan() to produce Workflow/AgentTask objects and translate string dependency references to UUID depends_on list. Retired legacy raw execution loops.
Refactored _get_jules() to resolve enabled accounts from DB/KeyVault directly and removed legacy plan_executor dependency.
Updated run_review_session to use JulesClient directly with a clean, localized polling loop instead of retired plan_executor helpers.
Replaced imported get_jules_key with a clean, localized version utilizing Database and KeyVault.
Refactored _resume_polling and _resume_pending_tasks to use local polling and GitHubClient helpers, and updated _daily_reset_loop to update DB sessions_today directly.
Updated retired get_jules_key import to reference core.auto_mode instead.
Added create_branch_from_ref and get_default_branch_sha helper methods to GitHubClient.

Updated run_task to acquire accounts with role/assign_to constraints, create branches dynamically via GitHubClient, and generate prompts using prompt_builder.build_session_prompt() for JDOCS compliance.
Enhanced acquire() to enforce hard assign_to constraints matching against account name or label.
Completely rewrote the execute_plan endpoint to leverage WorkflowEngine/AgentCoordinator (System A) with persistence, database updates, and correct integration branch/PR creation on completion.
Updated test_plan_parser assertions to support UUID-based depends_on and Pydantic Workflow objects.
Aligned gap tests with retired plan_executor functions, Pydantic AgentTask models, and localized API routing.

assumptions_verified.verification: Confirmed with user; retired buggy get_jules_key and poll_session_status, repointed other files to clean local or client-based implementations.
Confirmed with user; implemented create_branch_from_ref on GitHubClient and called it dynamically from AgentCoordinator.
Confirmed with user; switched AgentCoordinator prompt generation to use build_session_prompt(), utilizing its standard JDOCS master instructions.
Confirmed with user; enforced strict assign_to constraints raising AccountPoolExhausted with no fallback if not met.

decisions.decision: Implement localized polling/key helpers in non-workflow subsystems
decisions.reasoning: Insulates subsystems like server recovery, daily reset, auto-mode, and merge review from plan_executor removal while avoiding changing their scoped high-level business logic.

self_review.checked: All modified modules, schema files, test suite execution results, and import structures

notes_for_next_step: System B execution has been completely retired. All plan execution now runs consistently via the robust, role-aware, persistent System A engine.
